from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyQ1Report(BaseModel):
    """Snapshot of financial data for one company's Q1 2025 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Security code of the company, if available")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="End date of the reporting period, e.g. 2025-03-31")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets value in yuan")
    equity_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Equity attributable to shareholders of listed company in yuan")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts payable value in yuan")
    contract_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="Contract liabilities value in yuan")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyQ1Report]
